metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-aj[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Consolidate beads sidecar commits[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Cut routine beads-sidecar commit volume by making one logical [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]operation produce one commit and one push: `sase bead work` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]batch-marks every launched bead in-progress in a single pre-spawn [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]commit, runtime claim transitions become quiet no-ops, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]close-with-note lands in one command, projections serialize [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]deterministically so clones stop committing pure-reorder echoes, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and each agent `sase commit` writes at most one beads commit. Every[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sase bead` subcommand keeps committing and pushing by default.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]beads_commit_consolidation.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-aj[/#87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Idempotent claim mutations and epic-capable batch preclaim in [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]Rust core[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core: make runtime claim/close/update mutations quiet no-ops when they [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]would not change state, and extend the batch epic-work preclaim so it [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]can include the epic bead itself with the land agent assignment.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Skip commits and pushes on no-op bead mutations and batch the [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]claim chop[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]quiet[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]quiet: teach every Python bead-mutation caller to skip the commit and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]push entirely when the mutation outcome reports no change, treat [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in-progress-with-matching-assignee as a healthy held claim, and collapse[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the per-bead commit loops in the bead-claim-checks chop into one commit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and one push per cycle.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Single-commit epic launch in sase bead work[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]launch[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core, quiet[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]launch: batch-preclaim every launched phase bead and the epic bead [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inside the existing launch transaction so `sase bead work` produces [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exactly one beads commit and one synchronous pre-spawn push, with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]runner-side claim, promotion, and release falling through as no-ops.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Deterministic bead projection output[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]detproj[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]detproj: make `issues.jsonl` and every other regenerated projection [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]byte-stable across all writers so clones never dirty their worktree with[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pure reorders that later get swept into commits under recycled semantic [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]messages.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Close-with-note in one mutation and one commit[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]closenote[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]closenote: add a `--note` option to `sase bead close` that appends an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]attributed note entry and closes the bead in one mutation and one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit, then update the runtime working-loop guidance so agents stop [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]issuing separate note and close commands.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One beads commit per agent commit[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]postcommit[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]postcommit: fold the commit finalizer's bead-state sync commit and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bead-pages publication commit into a single beads-repo commit per agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit, and keep finalizer retry passes from re-committing when nothing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]changed.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
